title: fix(components): element:number shows a "no object named" state instead of a silent dash (objectui#10951)
body:
Fixes #10951
Clause-②: no — (a) is renderer-only plus one new locale-pack key, the same shape PR objectui#10101 declared `no`: no accept set relaxes, no manifest input moves, and no export is added. (b) did not land (measured below), so the published manifest's declared inputs are byte-unchanged.

Implemented on branch `claude/issue-10951-element-number-no-object-state` by the `os-dev` run dispatched from the `domain:ui` seat 2 session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (claim comment 5870572293 on the card, triage 5869415559).

## What changed

- **`ElementNumberRenderer`** (`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx`): when the node authors an `aggregate` and names no object in either place (no `properties.object`, and no `dataSource` whose `object` is a non-empty string, which is what `useElementDataSource` reads as status `absent`), the renderer draws a short muted notice (`text-xs text-muted-foreground`, test id `element-number-no-object`) instead of the silent dash. It queries nothing and does not throw.
  - **Authored absence only.** The branch sits after the two binding panels and requires status `absent`, so a binding that names an object keeps the loading panel while its `view` resolves and the error panel when the view fails to resolve.
  - **No aggregate:** unchanged. A node with no `aggregate` still paints the dash (measured on the base, pinned as a control below).
- **Localized:** the text is `t('element.number.noObject', { defaultValue })` through `useObjectTranslation` (the hook `elements.tsx` already imports). The key is added to all ten packs (`packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, new `element.number` namespace), zh-CN included: 「未指定对象：请设置 object 或 dataSource.object。」. English: "No object named: set object or dataSource.object." `check:i18n-keys` confirms the inline `defaultValue` equals the `en` value.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/guide/data-source.md` gains one sentence after the `element:number` paragraph describing the notice. The docs grep over `content/docs/**` (the `element:number` row and paragraphs in `data-source.md`) found no sentence this makes false.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/10951-element-number-no-object-state.md`, `'@object-ui/components': patch` and `'@object-ui/i18n': patch` (the second because the ten packs are `@object-ui/i18n` source).

## (b) measured: the manifest cannot say "`object` or `dataSource.object`" today

**Routed by the seat:** (b) is the maintainer's decision, on objectui#10991 (it recommends A: keep this notice and add no new gate). This PR closes objectui#10951 with (a), the runtime half; the authoring-time half rides that decision card, which also decides objectui#10508's calendar and gantt trade and `element:record_picker`.

Nothing was registered and nothing was invented. What was read on `origin/main` `deca847a8a`:

- **Input model.** `ManifestInput` (`packages/sdui-parser/src/types.ts`) carries `name`, `type`, `of`, `required?: boolean`, `enum`, `binding`, `description`. `ManifestComponent` carries `type`, `namespace`, `inputs`, `isContainer`, `tier`. There is no one-of, any-of, requiredAny or conditional-required form, and no component-level validator slot. The serializer forwards exactly that fixed per-input list (the list `component-input-retired-constraint-keys.test.ts` quotes: "`name`, `type`, `of`, `required`, `enum`, `binding`, `description`").
- **`validateTree`'s only presence rule** is per input and unconditional: `if (input.required && !(input.name in node))` draws `missing-required-prop`.
- **The per-tag checks inside `validateTree` are not registration hooks.** `checkKanbanQuickAdd` fires on `QUICK_ADD_HOST_TYPES = new Set(['object-kanban'])` and `checkDashboardWidgetOptions` on `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_HOST_TYPES` (`dashboard`, `dashboard-grid`). Both sets are hard-coded in the parser; no registration declares them and `sdui.manifest.json` does not carry them. A third arm for `element:number` would be a NEW parser rule, and the objectstack side runs a lockstep port of `packages/sdui-parser/src` (objectstack `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` records the file list and the `diagnosticCodes` set), so it is a cross-repo contract, not a registration.
- **Same trade as PR objectui#10508.** There the calendar's `objectName` lost `required: true` because the record source is one of `data` / `staticData` / `objectName`, and the description states the rule instead. `element:number` in PR objectui#10944 is the same shape; one answer covers both.

⇒ (b) goes back to the seat as an open question, with a four-axis analysis in the `os-dev-report` comment on the card.

## Pins: red on the base, green on the head

New files (both under `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/__tests__/`):

- `elementNumber.noObjectState-10951.test.tsx` (no provider, English `defaultValue`):
  - PIN "neither properties.object nor dataSource.object: the notice replaces the dash, and nothing is queried"
  - PIN "a dataSource that names no object is still authored absence" (`dataSource: { object: '' }`)
  - CONTROL "properties.object alone aggregates and paints the value"
  - CONTROL "dataSource.object alone aggregates and paints the value"
  - CONTROL "a binding whose view is still resolving keeps the loading panel, not the new state"
  - CONTROL "a binding whose view failed to resolve keeps the error panel, not the new state"
  - CONTROL "no aggregate and no object keeps the dash it paints today"
- `elementNumber.noObjectStateLocale-10951.test.tsx` (its own file, because `createI18n` installs a module-global instance):
  - PIN "renders the Chinese sentence under zh"
  - PIN "renders the German sentence under de"

| tree | command | result |
|---|---|---|
| base `deca847a8a` (the two test files copied in, nothing else) | `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over both files | `Tests  4 failed \| 5 passed (9)`: the 4 PIN rows fail with `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="element-number-no-object"]`; the 5 CONTROL rows pass |
| head `affc832f76` | same | `Tests  9 passed (9)` |

### Ablation, with each control lit

Every leg mutated the COMMITTED `elements.tsx` through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the anchor must hit once, the write is verified on disk by anchor count and blob hash, and the restore is proven by blob equal to the HEAD blob plus an empty `git diff HEAD`). The test imports the renderer through its relative `src` path, so no `dist` step sits between the mutation and the run.

| leg | mutation | red rows (everything else green) |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | condition replaced by `false` (both files run) | exactly the 4 PIN rows: `Tests  4 failed \| 5 passed (9)` |
| M2 | drop `!props.object` | CONTROL "properties.object alone …" |
| M3 | drop `props.aggregate` | CONTROL "no aggregate and no object …" |
| M4 | drop the `status === 'absent'` clause | CONTROL "dataSource.object alone …" |
| M5 | authored absence read off `props.object` alone, drawn ahead of the two panels | CONTROLs "dataSource.object alone …", "view is still resolving …", "view failed to resolve …" |

M5's first attempt was a no-op. `ablation-replace` refused it because the replacement re-contained its anchor ("the anchor count moved 1 to 1", paraphrased), and nothing ran. It was re-run with a non-overlapping anchor, and that run is the one reported above. Every leg ended with "ok restored: blob == HEAD (6c2e326522b8)".

## Gates (all on head `affc832f76`; heavy runs under `os-verify-lock`)

- **Dependency closure build:** `pnpm turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/components^..." --concurrency=2` → `Tasks: 7 successful, 7 total`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` → both `type-check: Done`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both new test files and `elements.tsx`.
- **Package suites:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 packages/components/ packages/i18n/` → `Test Files  401 passed | 1 skipped (402)`, `Tests  4380 passed | 37 skipped (4417)`, including `all-locales-key-parity` and `en-zh-key-parity`.
- **Every other test that reads `element:number` / `elements.tsx`** (`git grep` over `*.test.*`, 24 files in `apps/console`, `app-shell`, `cli`, `core`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-dashboard`, `react`, `types`, `scripts`), plus the five `scripts/__tests__` suites that read the locale packs whole → `Test Files  29 passed (29)`, `Tests  1931 passed (1931)`.
- **Console eager closure** (after `vite build` of `apps/console`, base and head built the same way in separate worktrees): `✅ Console eager closure is 3104.0 KB gzipped across 330 of 2446 chunks (budget: 3104.5 KB, headroom: 0.5 KB)`. The base read 3103.9 KB (headroom 0.6 KB) on this box. Delta: `eagerGzipBytes` 3178359 → 3178445 = **+86 bytes gzipped** (`ui-components` +78, `i18n-locale-en` +34, the rest hash churn). 563 bytes of headroom remain.
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues` exit 0 (`en` still the only eager catalogue); `check:sdui-registration-pins` exit 0.
- `check-changeset-presence` exit 0 ("13 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"); `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0; `check:pending-changeset-literals` exit 0; `check:changeset-claims` exit 0, report-only. It names three pending changesets (6661, 6726, 6783) that mention `en.ts` or `elements.tsx`, and all three paragraphs were re-read and are still true.
- `check:new-line-citations` → `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`; `check:control-bytes` OK; `docs:check-links` "Links are valid across 17 scan roots."; `check:doc-types` exit 0; `check:element-data-source-declaration` OK.
- i18n: `check:i18n-keys` exit 0; `check:i18n-drift` exit 0 ("1 key(s) added"); `check-i18n-dead-keys` does not list `element.number.noObject`.
- **Lint, narrowed and proven:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 13 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files → 13 files, 0 errors, 24 warnings. All 24 are in `elements.tsx` and the base file carries the same 24. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` (type-aware linting is off), so this diff cannot move a verdict on any file it did not touch.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` against a fresh `origin/main` (`42687baf20`) → exit 0, no conflicts.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch quoted the eager closure at 3103.4 KB. This box measured 3103.9 KB on the base (`vite build` of `apps/console` only, src aliases). The +86 byte delta is base against head on the same box.
- Not filed (polish, same family): the two shared binding panels (`ElementDataSourceErrorPanel` / `ElementDataSourceLoadingPanel` in `@object-ui/react`) and `element:image`'s "no image source" still render English literals. This PR does not touch them.
- If the seat routes (b)'s decision through this card rather than a separate one, line 1 should become `Part of #10951`, so the merge does not close a card in the decision box.
